units.source_text: 是晚二公主从宫中迁居三条院，仪式非常盛大。

en.t: That evening, the Second Princess moved from the palace to Sanjo-in, and the ceremony was extraordinarily grand.
All of the Emperor's ladies-in-waiting escorted her.

units.source_text: 二公主乘的是有庇的辇车。

en.t: The Second Princess rode in a hand-drawn carriage with a canopy.

units.source_text: 此外有无庇丝饰车三辆，黄金饰的槟榔毛车六辆，普通槟榔毛车二十辆，竹舆车二辆。

en.t: In addition, there were three silk-decorated carriages without canopies, six betel-palm-fiber carriages adorned with gold, twenty ordinary betel-palm-fiber carriages, and two bamboo palanquins.

units.source_text: 陪送的侍女共三十人，女童及仆役八人。

en.t: There were thirty ladies-in-waiting accompanying her, together with eight young girls and servants.

units.source_text: 薰大将方面来迎接的车有十二辆，是三条院本邸的侍女们所乘的。

en.t: From General Kaoru's side, twelve carriages came to receive her, carrying the ladies-in-waiting from the main residence at Sanjo-in.

units.source_text: 犒赏公卿及殿上人的物品，精美无以复加。

en.t: The gifts bestowed on the court nobles and courtiers were exquisite beyond compare.
